name: @linkpage/builder
//devDependencies: jsdom and the Testing Library pair are here rather than at the root because the renderer has no DOM to test and must stay dependency-free (§5.1). They are what lets the preview drawer be tested as a document — its one control, its srcdoc, its sandbox — without a browser in CI. Playwright is here for the same reason and no other: §5.3's single end-to-end needs a real browser, a real download and a real file on disk, which is exactly the boundary jsdom cannot cross. It is builder-side only — the renderer's dependencies block stays empty (invariant 3) — and @types/node is what lets the end-to-end read that file back.
